September 25, 2026

# Shopify Payments Balance Transaction GraphQL type supports currency conversion type

DateSeptember 25, 2026

Version[2026-10](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_version=2026-10)

FlagsUpdate

SurfacesAPI

Affected APIs[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/changelog?api_type=admin-graphql)

As of GraphQL Admin API version **2026-10**, ShopifyPaymentsTransactionType now includes `CURRENCY_CONVERSION` type.

Learn more about `ShopifyPaymentsTransactionType` on [Shopify.dev](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql/2024-10/enums/ShopifyPaymentsTransactionType).
